主要内容: On March 25, 2021, Geospace Technologies Corporation (GEO, NMS) amended its loan agreement with Frost Bank, reducing the maximum borrowing amount from $30 million to $20 million, subject to a borrowing base. The amendment expanded the definition of 'Eligible Accounts' to include certain unbilled receivables and reduced the limit on 'Eligible Inventory' from $2,000,000 to $1,500,000. It also adjusted the tangible net worth financial covenant, lowering the minimum threshold from $145 million to $132 million, effective for the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2021. Additionally, the amendment introduced a funded debt to EBITDA ratio covenant, requiring the company to maintain a ratio not exceeding 1.50 to 1.00 for a twelve-month period ending on the last day of each fiscal quarter, starting with the fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2021. The amendment is referenced in Exhibit 10.1, which is incorporated by reference. The company's CFO, Robert L. Curda, signed the report on March 29, 2021.
